summary: Uses VkFFT to run DFT or inverse DFT operations on TOP image data, with polar or cartesian RG interpretations.

key_params.name: chan
key_params.note: Input channel used for forward DFT.

common_gotchas: Keep coordinate mode consistent between DFT output and IDFT input.
DFT output RG meaning changes between polar and cartesian modes.
Transform Rows changes the operation from whole-image to row-wise transforms.
IDFT expects a 32-bit RG input; ordinary color images need DFT preparation first.
key_concepts: Spectrum TOP uses the VkFFT library to perform discrete Fourier transforms or inverse transforms.
DFT mode reads one selected input channel and outputs a 32-bit RG texture.
IDFT mode expects a 32-bit RG texture and outputs a 32-bit mono result.
Coordinate mode decides whether RG means magnitude/phase or real/imaginary.
